description: This PHP source file defines the 'StudioTree' class, which extends 'MBPackageTree'. It appears to be part of the SuiteCRM module builder, specifically related to the user interface tree structure for Studio within the module builder. It includes methods for constructing the tree, getting the name of the tree section, and initializes necessary components such as 'StudioBrowser'.

classes.name: StudioTree
classes.description: Represents a tree structure within the SuiteCRM Studio interface, extending MBPackageTree. It initializes a Tree object and a StudioBrowser to populate the tree with nodes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tree and populates it with nodes retrieved from StudioBrowser.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the localized name of this tree section, using the translate function for the label 'LBL_SECTION_MODULES'.
